notes: Sourced from Kramer's official VP-550X User Manual (P/N 2900-301496 Rev 1, kramerav.com/downloads/VP-550X), which includes a labeled rear-panel diagram and a Technical Specifications table -- this is the authoritative manufacturer source. All 26 rear-panel callouts were extracted directly. Terminal-block audio/control ports (MIC, AUX, VGA audio, CV audio, LINE OUT, CTRL IN, CTRL OUT) are 3-pin or 5-pin captive screw terminal blocks; mapped to the closest listed connector id "euroblock" since no more specific terminal-block id exists in the allowed set. The MIC input is a combo-style 3-pin terminal (tip/ring/sleeve equivalent) supporting both condenser (48V phantom, switchable) and dynamic mics -- not modeled as a combo connector since both configurations use the same physical 3-pin block. HDMI inputs/outputs are graded hdmi-2.0 per the manual's explicit statement ("as specified in HDMI 2.0", HDCP 2.2, 4K@60Hz 4:4:4). The Ethernet RJ-45 port's link speed is not explicitly stated in the manual (only default TCP/UDP ports and static IP are given); eth-100m grade is inferred as the conservative default for a control-oriented RJ-45 on this device class -- treat this grade as medium-confidence. The mains inlet appears in the rear-panel photo as a standard 3-prong IEC-style receptacle with an adjacent fuse holder and rocker power switch, consistent with an IEC C13/C14 connector (the manual just calls it "Mains Socket" without specifying C13/C14 vs C7/C19; C13/14 is the visually correct match at this power draw of 1A @ 100-240VAC). No physical IR input/output jack exists on the rear panel -- IR is handled via a front-panel receiver for the included remote, not a wired port, so it was not included as a port. USB-C is a video-input-only port (with charging), not a host/data USB-C, so no eth/usb grade was assigned beyond noting its power-delivery function in the note field.
